newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Livshits takes over debt from Davydov.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Livshits takes over debt from Davydov.

text.p: Finance Minister Alexander Livshits will take over responsibilities for Russia's foreign debt from Oleg Davydov, Minister of Foreign Economic Relations, said a government resolution published on Monday.
Livshits will become head of the government commission on foreign debt and financial assets, said the resolution on the re-distribution of vice-premiers' portfolios, which was dated November 10.
It was not immediately clear whether Davydov, who had been Russia's chief debt negotiator, retained any responsibilities for foreign debt.
Livshits also takes over from Davydov as head of the tariff and customs commission and will head a government commission on public-sector wages.

Deputy Prime Minister Valery Serov will head the working group on talks with Kazakhstan on Kazakh oil exports through Russia, joint exploitation of the Karachaganak oil and gas deposit and Caspian Sea problems.
Serov will also take over First Deputy Prime Minister Alexei Bolshakov's responsibilities as head of the commission on Commonwealth of Independent States affairs, the resolution said.
First Deputy Prime Minister Vladimir Potanin will be responsible for a federal commission on budget revenues from privatisation.
Bolshakov, who deputises for Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin and is responsible for industrial issues, will head a commission supervising privatisation of defence companies, it said.
The government has also set up an interdepartmental commission on reforms in natural monopolies, headed by Economy Minister Yevgeny Yasin, a separate resolution said.
